posts.title: ⚠ TEST · Jujutsu Emergency Network
posts.body:
THIS IS A TEST. THIS IS ONLY A TEST.
The Jujutsu Emergency Network is running a scheduled test of its curse warning system for all registered sorcerers of Sendai Jujutsu High.
If this were a real emergency, you would receive the threat grade, the affected area and your evacuation or deployment orders.
No action is required. Do not leave the barrier.
— Sendai Jujutsu High, Office of the Assistant Managers

posts.title: Welcome to Jujutsu High!
posts.body:
On Behalf of everyone at the Staff of Sendai Jujutsu High Faculty we welcome you into the Jujutsu High First Years, you might notice that the campus has been empty lately.
This is because you are the first new generation of Sorcerers, you have been assigned 3 teachers

1. Sento Gojo - Curse Energy Manipulation and Barrier Proficiency
2. Todoya Katsu - Curse Technique Manipulation and Combat Sports
3. Ryo Yoruo - Barrier Knowledge and Tool Combat

These teachers will accompany you through the next 3 years of School

FaQ:
- When will I go on missions?
: First Year students do not go on missions anywhere, the only Missions that will be shown to you are sideline viewed missions supervised by your teachers

Have Fun.. and we wish you the best!!
